auth.title: Sign in
auth.lede: Use your email or username and your password.
auth.signOutBody: You’ll need your password and authenticator code to sign back in.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
auth.codeLede: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
auth.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in could not load. Check your connection or ad blocker.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign-in did not go through. Try again.
auth.googleClosed: Sign-up is by invitation on this server: ask a workspace owner for an invite link.
auth.googleRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth.googleError: Something went wrong signing you in with Google. Try again in a moment.
auth.useGoogle: Passwords are for Admins only here. Continue with Google instead.
auth.adminsLede: Admins sign in with their password. Everyone else continues with Google.
auth.googleInvite: This invite link is invalid, already used, expired, or meant for another Google account.
auth.googleAdmin: This is an Admin account: Admins sign in with their username and password.
auth.setupLede: Admins sign in with two factors. Scan this code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
auth.signOutBodyGoogle: You can sign back in any time with Continue with Google.
